detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Upgrade to the Deluxe Edition to receive the following bonus content:

- Exclusive Outfit: Forsaken Skeleton

- Exclusive Background: Shipwreck Coast

- Exclusive Earrings: Web of Fate

- Exclusive Pose: Justice

- Exclusive Emotes: Pip's Daily Life

- Exclusive Avatar: Dew

- Exclusive Avatar Frame: Light Feather

- Fate Coin x2,500

Fate Coins can be used to purchase various cosmetic items in-game.

Deluxe Edition bonuses can only be claimed once per account. Additional purchases will not grant duplicate bonuses.
